title: Sombr Sets 2027 Arena Tour of Australia and New Zealand
summary: Frontier Touring is producing the five-city trek, which gets underway April 13 at Adelaide’s ​AEC Arena.
contentText:
When Sombr returns to Australia and New Zealand next year, he’ll play the biggest arenas in both markets.

The U.S. pop phenom will visit five cities on the domestic leg of his You Are The Reason Tour, all of them locked away for April 2027.

Frontier Touring is producing the trek, which gets underway April 13 at Adelaide’s ​AEC Arena, followed by Melbourne’s Rod Laver Arena (April 15), ​Brisbane Entertainment Centre (April 19), Sydney’s ​Afterpay Arena (April 22) and coming to a halt April 27 at Auckland’s ​Spark Arena.

Sombr was last in these parts in December 2025 when he played a sold-out run of theaters and impressed at the 2025 edition of Spilt Milk festival.

Now aged 21, Sombr’s debut album  I Barely Know Her  opened at No. 6 on the ARIA Chart in August 2025, and almost immediately climbed into the top 5. Also last year, the New Yorker bagged three top 10 hits on Australia’s national singles chart: “Undressed” (which peaked at No. 2), “Back To Friends” (No. 3) and “12 To 12” (No. 6). His 2026 release “Homewrecker” went to No. 6.

Sombr has been hot stuff in his homeland, too. Last year, he confirmed his status has one to watch thanks to his breakout singles “Undressed” and “Back to Friends,” which launched him to the top of the Hot 100 Songwriters  ranking for a month-long stretch. His debut album  I Barely Know Her  peaked at No. 10 on the  Billboard 200  last September, and “Homewrecker” and 2026 release “Potential” both charted on the Billboard Hot 100.

Tickets for the ANZ tour go on sale from 12pm local time on Tuesday, Sept. 8. For tickets and tour information visit  frontiertouring.com/sombr .
